name: 64470 · Mound City, MO
findings: ZIP 64470 (Mound City) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64470 (Mound City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64470 (Mound City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
